newsitem.title: USA: Wild Wings, Mid-Ag reorganize as Red Oak.
newsitem.headline: Wild Wings, Mid-Ag reorganize as Red Oak.

text.p: Wild Wings Inc of Nevada said it signed an agreement to acquire 100 percent of Mid-Ag LLC of Red Oak, Iowa in a stock-for-stock tax-free exchange, with the new public entity to be known as Red Oak Hereford Farms Inc.
It said Red Oak Hereford Farms will continue to be a producer, promoter and exclusive sales agency for Certified Hereford Beef, as part of an agreement with the American Hereford Association.
Mid-Ag said it doubled revenues to $60 million in 1996 from $30 million in 1995 while processing more than 60,000 cattle in the same year.
